findings.text: Range assignment makes every position inside a closed interval observe the newly stored value while neighbors outside keep their prior values, clearing with a null value removes coverage so later loads report absence, and clearing the entire span can return a populated tree to an empty state.

Extensive overwrites that split combine and rebalance nodes preserve lookup results and successful validation, height remains small during moderate population and grows toward four only after many sequential intervals on wide builds while narrow builds stay shorter.

A cursor associated with one tree holds a current position and interval, lookup establishes the entry covering the position, forward iteration advances toward an upper bound and reverse iteration retreats toward a lower bound, each reporting absence once the bound is passed and exposing the interval and node of the located entry.

Reverse empty area search seeks the highest sufficiently large unoccupied span inside caller supplied limits and moves the cursor start to that span, gaps created by erasing isolated entries or clearing intervals remain findable when they lie within one node or across node and level boundaries.

Read only walks and iterations execute inside a read side critical section that is entered before the first lookup and exited after the last use, mutating sequences instead hold a cursor associated exclusive guard while establishing ranges and performing stores, with explicit reset between independent searches.

Traversal state comprises a tree reference plus current lower and upper positions and a reference to the node holding the current entry, supported by helpers to select a single position or an interval, to restart the state, and to query emptiness height and root condition.

Trees created in allocation range mode accept appending at either end without affecting far away content, partial overwrites of predecessor and successor intervals, modifications while in read copy update mode, and erasure driven rebalancing, followed by validation and non empty height confirmation.

Tests inject synthetic allocation pressure through graded non kernel settings around store erase and overwrite batches and always restore the default setting and destroy the tree afterwards, so leaked pressure or missing cleanup would distort later scenarios.

Constant ULONG_MAX denotes end of key space and bound for full span operations while flag MT_FLAGS_ALLOC_RANGE requests gap aware accounting at creation and selector MAPLE_32BIT distinguishes expected height growth between narrow and wide configurations.

Initialization time checks cover backward traversal, null range stores, root expansion including tagged pointer values, deficient node construction, gap combining across nodes, bulk overwrite stress, and repeated performance loops for slot and node stores plus walks loads and iteration.

Performance loops first build a strided population of short intervals then repeat one focused operation very many times, including single position clear and restore, sliding overwrites of a wider span, point loads, full tree walks, reverse empty searches, and forward then backward iteration with result validation.
